calibration_flag.observed: Selected every offered weakness despite contrary CV evidence; asked £90-95k while earning ~£95k; reported current pay as £70-85k when it is £88,250 plus bonus.
calibration_flag.impact: Now the top-priority gap. Costs money in a single conversation rather than over a year.

constraints: 150-400 total study hours over the runway — supports one substantial project plus focused study, not three parallel tracks
3.5 years at current employer: narrative needs progression within the role, not just duration
Long career (from 1997) invites age bias in parts of the market; position on judgement and breadth rather than algorithm puzzles
